projects.title: E-Seal Prototype
projects.description: First open-source CSC v2 compliant remote e-sealing service. Full working prototype: 6 API endpoints, TypeScript client SDK (8 modules, 24 tests), live demo with SSE Process X-Ray, PAdES B-T signatures with RFC 3161 timestamps. Hash-only privacy model - documents never leave client infrastructure.

stack.builtWith: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, node-forge, pdf-lib, @signpdf, jose
stack.services: Neon PostgreSQL (tenants, credentials, audit log, SAD tokens), Sectigo Qualified TSA (RFC 3161 timestamps), Vercel (hosting + serverless API), Swagger UI (interactive API docs)
stack.howItWorks: Client SDK computes SHA-256 of PDF byte ranges locally (document never leaves client), builds CMS SignedAttributes, then calls CSC v2 API: OAuth2 token, SCAL2 PIN authorization (SAD token), signHash. Server signs with RSA PKCS#1 v1.5. SDK assembles CMS/PKCS#7 SignedData, fetches RFC 3161 timestamp, injects into PDF placeholder. Output: PAdES B-T sealed PDF validated by EU DSS.

stack.builtWith: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, bcryptjs, Intersection Observer API
stack.services: Neon PostgreSQL (tenants, credentials), Sectigo Qualified TSA (RFC 3161 timestamps), Vercel (hosting + serverless API)

stack.services: Google OAuth (YouTube + login), Neon PostgreSQL (library + history), ytmusicapi (YouTube Music search + radio discovery), YouTube Data API v3 (playlist creation), Vercel (frontend), Render (backend)
stack.howItWorks: Upload DJ library CSV, pick dice mode (random or deep), set output size.
